briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate frontier model race amid compute crunch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models this month. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount over uncontrolled deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning while Anthropic launched Claude 4.5. Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 and xAI's Grok-3 beta entered testing, with Meta open-sourcing Llama 4 variants.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Google announced new 100MW data center clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks slow US labs enough for Chinese competitors to close the frontier gap by 2028?
